lines.en: Hello. I'm the applicant, Kim Minsu.

lines.beaver: 일할 때 가장 중요한 신념이 있나요?
lines.beaver_en: Do you have a key belief when you work?
lines.beaver_roman: Ilhal ttae gajang jungyohan sinnyeomi innayo?
lines.learner: 네, 제 신념은 끝까지 책임지는 것입니다.
lines.en: Yes, my belief is to take responsibility to the end.
lines.roman: Ne, je sinnyeomeun kkeutkkaji chaegimjineun geosimnida.

lines.learner: 무책임한 사람은 아무리 유능해도 믿기 어렵습니다.
lines.en: An irresponsible person is hard to trust, however competent.
lines.roman: Muchaegimhan sarameun amuri yuneunghaedo mitgi eoryeopseumnida.

lines.learner: 경험은 짧으나 배우려는 의지는 누구보다 강합니다.
lines.en: My experience is short, but my will to learn is stronger than anyone's.
lines.roman: Gyeongheomeun jjalbeuna baeuryeoneun uijineun nuguboda gangamnida.

lines.beaver_en: Aren't you a bit passive, perhaps?
lines.en: No. I'm not passive; I'm active.

lines.beaver_en: Could you give me an example?
lines.learner: 야간 근무가 많았으나 먼저 나서서 맡았습니다.
lines.en: There were many night shifts, but I stepped up and took them on first.
lines.roman: Yagan geunmuga manasseuna meonjeo naseoseo matatseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have any special talent?
lines.learner: 큰 재주는 없으나 사람들과 잘 어울립니다.
lines.en: I have no great talent, but I get along well with people.
lines.roman: Keun jaejuneun eopseuna saramdeulgwa jal eoullimnida.

lines.beaver: 그렇군요. 일이 힘들 때는 어떻게 버티나요?
lines.beaver_en: I see. How do you hold up when work gets hard?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureokunyo. iri himdeul ttaeneun eotteoke beotinayo?
lines.learner: 힘들 때도 처음 마음가짐을 잊지 않습니다.
lines.en: Even when it's hard, I don't forget my first mindset.
lines.roman: Himdeul ttaedo cheoeum maeumgajimeul itji ansseumnida.

lines.beaver: 좋네요. 마지막으로 하고 싶은 말이 있나요?
lines.beaver_en: Good. Anything you'd like to say last?
lines.beaver_roman: Jonneyo. Majimageuro hago sipeun mari innayo?
lines.en: I'm lacking, but I'll work hard with an active attitude.

lines.beaver: 수고하셨습니다. 결과는 다음 주에 알려 드릴게요.
lines.beaver_en: Thank you for your time. We'll let you know the result next week.
lines.beaver_roman: Sugohasyeotseumnida. Gyeolgwaneun daeum jue allyeo deurilgeyo.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll wait for good news.
